Method of Attack: Encrypts all files on a computer using Salsa20 and RSA-4096 encryption algorithms
Checks Windows language and terminates if set to Ukrainian, Belarusian, Russian, or Kazakh
Clears Shadow Volume Copies using vssadmin.exe delete shadows /all /quiet
Encrypts all files except those in system and certain folders
Appends a 4-character extension to encrypted files based on CPUID
Creates ransom note # decrypt my files #.txt in each encrypted folder and desktop
Changes desktop background to a specific image stored at %LocalAppData%\Tempdesk.bmp
Attempts to encrypt files on network shares by enumerating shares with WNetEnumResourceW
Bruteforces network share credentials using embedded username and password list and mounts shares with WNetAddConnection2W
Attack Vector: Malvertising campaigns redirecting victims to RIG exploit kit
Indicators of Compromise: Ransom note text containing 'Attention! Your computer has been attacked by virus-encoder!'
